unit.why: R. Simcha Bunem of Przysucha tells his disciples how he came before the Holy Jew, shamed and pale, and finally admitted that the book Shevet Musar had shamed him; the narrator then adds a homiletic commentary.
unit.boundary_note: an unrelated footnote (ובר״ח שער הקדושה... on not talking during the cantor's repetition) is inserted mid-text after 'שפ״א א)'; the story text resumes at 'סוד נסע ובא'

stories.end_quote: והבעל שבט עושר הוכיחו ממש עכ"ל
stories.summary_en: R. Bunem of Przysucha tells how the Holy Jew saw his downcast face and pressed him to name the man who had shamed him; the 'man' turned out to be the musar book Shevet Musar, which R. Bunem then kissed, and the Holy Jew rejoiced at his wisdom; the narrator draws a lesson about how to read musar books.
